title: Package manifest, version 1
description: A partner's manifest as the shop's administrator installs it from the Retail Extension Package screen or a sandbox's API. The schema holds the manifest's own shape: its name, prefix and version (required, major.minor.patch) and the kinds it may carry. Every element inside a kind is judged by the checker itself, inside the site, at the check and again at the install (business_logic/manifest_check.py validate). Page: docs/extending/package_install.md.

app.description: The prefix in lower case with underscores.

prefix.description: One to three upper-case words; every field the manifest adds to the shop's record types starts with it.

not.description: Never a first word the system starts the names of flags it reads with (the checker's RESERVED_PREFIX_WORDS).

version.description: major.minor.patch, compared as numbers: an update must be higher.

app_user_rights.description: What the app's own user may do at the till, by Retail Permission field name: the install gives it these rights and every other right off, a row for every store, and a Shift Profile, all named in the one consent.

doctypes.description: The doctypes the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py). A settings record (issingle) is never also a table of rows (istable).

custom_fields.description: The custom fields the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

property_setters.description: The property setters the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

print_formats.description: The print formats the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

notifications.description: The notifications the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py). A notification never attaches a file a field names (attach_files, from_attach_field): it can be any private file on the site.

workspaces.description: The workspaces the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py). A workspace is the app's page, opened from the App library; it is never added to the menu: it installs out of the Desk's menu, limited to the app's roles and System Manager.

sale_attributes.description: The sale attributes the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

webhooks.description: The webhooks the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

reports.description: The reports the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

number_cards.description: The number cards the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

dashboard_charts.description: The dashboard charts the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

dashboards.description: The dashboards the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

list_settings.description: The list settings the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

workflows.description: The workflows the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

naming_rules.description: The naming rules the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

links.description: The links the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

registered_applications.description: The event feed the manifest installs (one per app: list every record type it follows in its events): checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py). The install makes the app's own user, <app>@integration.invalid, with the role <PREFIX> Integration alone, and names it on the feed.

remote_keys.description: The remote keys the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

extension_modules.description: The certified modules the manifest installs: each carries its bytes in base64 (wasm), the certificate our certify service gave it, its extension point and its version. The checker checks the bytes against sha256; the shop checks the certificate when it installs the module, switched off behind its service. A module's service is an extension_subscriptions entry with transport wasm that names the module's key. Page: docs/extending/package_install.md.

extension_subscriptions.description: The extension subscriptions the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

desk_actions.description: The desk actions the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py), which also refuses an input type the product refuses.

save_rules.description: The save rules the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

fiscal_readers.description: The fiscal readers the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py).

list_marks.description: The list marks the manifest installs: each element is checked by the installer's checker inside the site (business_logic/manifest_check.py), and again by the record's own validate at install.

register_books.description: The regulated-stock register books the manifest installs: each element is the register_book contract (register_book.v1.schema.json), checked by the installer's checker inside the site and again by the record's own validate at install, which reads every name a book names on the site.

translations.description: The package's own words, one entry per language: each maps a source text (a record type's name, a field or section label, a help text, a Select option) to its words. A label or option of a record type the manifest names is written for that record type only; every other word for the whole site, never over a word the site already translates. Installed, changed by an update and removed at uninstall with the package. Page: docs/extending/package_install.md, Words in a language.

language.description: A language code, e.g. ar or es-MX.

role_rights.description: Rights for one of the app's OWN roles (named with its prefix) on any record type, the retailer's included (since 2.1.0, X109): the install writes one level-0 permission row per entry, with exactly these rights on, and never touches a row the retailer already gave that role; an update rewrites the row unless the retailer changed it; the uninstall removes it. A right for a role that is not the app's own is refused: the retailer gives their own roles rights in Role Permissions Manager. Page: docs/extending/package_install.md.

records.description: Default records made at install if missing, as the administrator would in Desk (since 2.1.0, X109): by name, else by the plain values given; never written over, never a document that posts (the retailer's to make) nor one of the till's own records (the till writes them as it sells); on the app's own settings record, values are set where the field is empty. An update rewrites the values unless the retailer changed them; the uninstall removes a row that is unchanged and unlinked, and names what it kept. Page: docs/extending/package_install.md.
